blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style water well. The base is a circular stone wall built from dark grey fieldstones stacked three layers high. Two thick vertical wooden posts rise from opposite sides of the stone rim, supporting a pitched wooden roof clad in overlapping reddish-brown timber shingles/planks. Between the posts is a horizontal wooden axle or winch with coiled rope holding a hanging wooden bucket. On the right-hand post, a crank handle protrudes outward for raising the bucket. Textures are hand-painted / stylized with warm brown woods and neutral grey stone. All geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without floating or melted elements.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it is dominated by a rectangular brown timber gabled roof with a central ridge beam and tiled eaves on either side, with the round stone well base slightly visible underneath and the wooden crank handle extending outward to the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: The roof ridge reaches approximately 6 to 6.5 ft tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), and the stone base is around 3.5 to 4 ft in diameter.
